subject: science
concept: Completing a full independent capstone research project from question through final written report and presentation, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content, synthesizing the full K-12 science sequence — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student tracks their capstone through question/literature-review/design/data/analysis/limitations/report stages
exercise.abstract: Student completes an independent capstone research project: an original testable question, rigorous design, real data, honest analysis, and a clearly communicated final report

assessment.mastery_threshold: capstone demonstrates all stages: original question, sound design, real data collection, appropriate analysis, honest limitations, and clear final communication
misconception_flags: completes individual stages competently but the final report doesn't connect them into one coherent scientific narrative

interest_binding: full capstone project topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
